name: dalooka_smooth
description: a chain of spirals in ice white and steel blue: navy-edged blue clouds, rust and peach hot cores along a crackled lace spine

reference.made_with: an escape-time deep zoom of the Mandelbrot set, unsigned, 2560x1600

reuses: seahorse_halo's stack: the smooth count through the matched map by rank at 1.5 cycles, the reference's band order
glow_filaments' falloff glow on de, painted near-black and multiplied at half opacity: the dark hair that keeps the lace crisp
the tone pass, at the reference's median and p10
notes: Added: nothing: the smooth count through dalooka_smooth by rank at 1.5 cycles, a dark `de` hair, the tone pass

Fitted: the first map gave rust a third of the frame; holding the rust and peach to a narrow span and running a peach-white back to white held all 16 pool drafts. The reference's stippled grain is not drawn. Locations are degree-2 seats from the default draw (no spirals, Matt's ruling).

Lessons: item 031 brought six references Matt liked for their palette and its colour cycling, all close to plain smooth escape time, so each is seahorse_halo's light stack (the smooth count through a cyclic matched map by rank, a dark `de` hair, the tone pass) with its own map and cycle count, no new primitive. The cycle count is read off the reference's band order from the far field to the spiral's heart. The maps were fitted on pool drafts: a map whose dark stops are narrow misses p10 high at every seat (the tone pass pins the median but cannot make a dark the map does not spend), fixed by widening the dark stops, never by darkening the interior. The spiral references (forest, council, crisis, corkscrew) are scouted with `style scout --spiral` (Matt's ruling on item 031: only when the reference itself is a spiral); mandelbrot3 and dalooka with the default draw.
